Dear Mr Fletcher,

Re: Flat 10, 180 Alder Lane, Cedarford, ZZ3 4ZZ – Ref R/PM010-1

Thank you for your email of 17 January. Unfortunately we can't see a photo attached to it – it may not have come through.

Please could you reply to this email with a clear photo of the solar panel meter showing the current reading? If it's easier, you're welcome to just reply with the attachment and nothing else.

Many thanks,
Northbridge Lettings
